Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

fortify verb and noun

also fortification, defences, rampart, earthwork, palisade, entrenchment, build defences

classical

Cic. Prov. Cons. 34: Alpibus Ītaliam mūnierat ante nātūra (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 2.5: castra vallō fossāque mūnīre (Lewis & Short)

mūniō, mūnīre, mūnīvī (mūniī), mūnītum

conjugation

build a wall round, fortify; protect, secure

Other words

  • mūnītiō, mūnītiōnis f. — a fortifying; a fortification, defences

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Caes. BG 1.49: mīlitēs mūnītiōne prohibēre (Lewis & Short); Sall. Jug. 38.6: per mūnītiōnem introīre (Lewis & Short)

  • vallum, vallī n. — a rampart set with stakes, a palisaded earthwork

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Caes. BG 2.5: castra vallō fossāque mūnīre (Lewis & Short); Cic. Att. 9.12.3: aliquem vallō et fossā saeptum tenēre (Lewis & Short)

  • mūnīmentum, mūnīmentī n. — a defence, a fortification, a rampart; a protection

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Liv. 1.33.7: fossa, haud parvum mūnīmentum (Lewis & Short); Caes. BG 2.17 (Lewis & Short)

  • mūnītus, mūnīta, mūnītum — fortified, defended, safe

    declension · also used · classical · Cic. Verr. 2.5.39: nūllīus pudīcitia mūnīta contrā tuam cupiditātem et audāciam posset esse (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • Alpibus Ītaliam mūnierat ante nātūra

    nature had already fortified Italy with the AlpsCic. Prov. Cons. 34 (Lewis & Short)

  • crēscēbat interim urbs mūnītiōnibus alia atque alia appetendō loca

    meanwhile the city was growing, taking in one place after another with its defencesLiv. 1.8.4

  • castra vallō fossāque mūnīre

    to fortify a camp with a rampart and a ditchCaes. BG 2.5 (Lewis & Short)

  • fossa, haud parvum mūnīmentum

    a ditch, no small defenceLiv. 1.33.7 (Lewis & Short)

  • nūllīus pudīcitia mūnīta contrā tuam cupiditātem et audāciam posset esse

    no one’s chastity could be safe against your lust and effronteryCic. Verr. 2.5.39 (Lewis & Short)

See also wall, strengthen.
